pages.title: Sword of the Free Will
pages.text: §lWeapon Effects: §r$(br)Armor +10, 25% damage reduction, with built-in Sharpness XII, Smite XII, Looting XII, Knockback II, Dawn I, and Eternal Spark I.$(br2)§lActive Skill "Human Will": §r$(br)Right-click to activate. Damage +150% for 10 minutes, with a 90% chance to summon lightning on each attack; costs 25% health and has a 15-minute cooldown.
